newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn closes firmer on soybean rally.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn closes firmer on soybean rally.

text.p: CBOT corn futures closed quietly higher on a rally in soybean futures, traders said.
The impressive close in the soy complex helped chip away at bearishness that stemmed from slow exports, they said.
Trading volume was thin with the market in a holiday trading mode and there was little to move the market one way or another with many local traders not on the floor due to the Christmas Day holiday.
CBOT futures trading closed early Tuesday at 1201 CST and the markets will remain closed Wednesday, Christmas Day.
Funds bought the market and commercials sold it.
Refco Inc bought two million bushels of March and bought 1.5 million May, traders said. Term Commodities, the marketing arm of Louis Dreyfus Corp, sold two million bushels of May.
Corn futures volume was estimated at 20,000 contracts, below the 27,829 traded Monday, according to the CBOT.
In corn options, LFG Futures sold 200 May $2.60 calls and sold 200 May $2.80 puts at 12-1/2 cents, traders said.
Corn options volume was estimated at 6,000 contracts, below the 6,695 traded Monday.
Corn futures closed 3/4 cent per bushel lower to 2-1/2 cents higher, with March up 1/4 at $2.66-3/4.
